title: Editorial Print
line: A magazine spread that moves: serif headlines on warm newsprint, one red, a halftone tooth.
line_zh: 会动的杂志版面：暖色新闻纸上的衬线大标题，一抹红，网点质感。
prompt: Editorial print style: serif headlines on warm newsprint, near-black ink and one red accent, a light halftone and paper tooth, mask-rise type, calm wipes and pushes, a marimba bed with paper flips. No glow, no neon.
prompt_zh: 编辑印刷风格：暖色新闻纸上的衬线大标题，近黑墨色加一抹红，轻微网点与纸纹，遮罩上升字效，平静的擦除与推移转场，马林巴配乐加翻纸声。不要发光，不要霓虹。
essence: Type carries the film the way a well-set magazine page does: a serif voice, generous margins and one colour that marks the word that matters. Texture is printed, never glossy.

not.difference: Swiss Grid is a sans grid with hard cuts; Editorial Print is a serif voice on textured paper with soft wipes.
Documentary Grain is dark, filmic and warm amber; Editorial Print is a light printed page.

palette.logic: a warm newsprint ground, near-black ink, ONE editorial red for the key word; nothing else is saturated

camera.expresses: leaning in to read the key line
a slow drift across a printed page

sound.foley: paper flips and a rubber stamp on the reveal

signature_features.text: a serif display face (STIX Two Text) on every headline
ink on paper at 15:1 and the red accent at 5:1 or more (contrast.py)
only wipes, pushes, mask reveals and dips between sections; no glitch or static
a marimba or folk bed under paper and stamp sounds
paper tooth and a light halftone visible on the flat ground at phone size

demo.lint: mp lint 97.3/100, 52 PASS, 4 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 13 N/A
demo.made_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) through mp plan --style, mp new, mp render (HyperFrames, CRF 18) and mp lint; 0 human rounds; the same placeholder copy in every style

honesty: The demo is one run on a neutral placeholder subject (a fictional late-night library, labelled placeholder). The same prompt makes a different film on every run.
